The '''Annex of Kespan''', named after [[Gavail Kespan]], was the oldest ruin on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]], which was on the verge of collapse by [[3641 BBY]]. A [[Sarkhai guild]] asked the Sarkhai representative in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Nadia Grell]] for permission from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to demolish the ruin and build a new [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on its site.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Annex of Kespan is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Nadia Grell's companion storyline. The decision on whether to preserve or demolish the ruin is made by the player, who suggests the solution to Nadia.<ref name="SWTOR" />
